name: Timor-Leste: the Constitution (2002) and Lei n.º 11/2009, Divisão Administrativa do Território
label: Timor-Leste
record_note: The Constitution of 2002 (never amended) and Lei n.º 11/2009 in every version from 2009 to its fourth amendment (Lei n.º 19/2023) and the deferred third (Lei n.º 14/2023, in effect 2024-01-01). Every version of Lei 11/2009 is an official republication.

scope.when_absent: no scope note found; not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: no retroactive restriction of rights; no retroactive criminal law unless more favourable
default_reach.meaning: laws restricting rights, freedoms and guarantees cannot have retroactive effect, and criminal law does not apply retroactively unless the new law benefits the accused
default_reach.authority: Constituição da RDTL, artigo 24.º, n.º 2 ("não podem ter efeito retroactivo") and artigo 31.º, n.º 5 ("A lei penal não se aplica retroactivamente, a menos que a nova lei beneficie o arguido.")
